purpose: Add deterministic translation-only single-axis locks around the preserved AXM Physics Core so one world-space x or y offset can be constrained while orthogonal translation remains free.

properties.locks: bounded array of explicit x/y world-axis translation locks
properties.options: optional bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

relationships.basis: A translation mount locks both world-space offset components; an axis lock constrains exactly one caller-selected x or y component and intentionally leaves the orthogonal component free.

limitations: axis does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
connected locked bodies still collide unless caller collision filters suppress them
standalone in this run and not yet inserted into the mixed constraint composer
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced
persistent_state: axis-lock definitions are explicit caller-owned JSON data

proves: kinematic-carrier following on the locked axis

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly world-axis translation only and refuses to call itself a full slider/prismatic joint because angular/local-anchor semantics do not exist yet.

agency.basis: The caller explicitly chooses x or y, target offset, correction factors and bounded iteration counts.

continuity.basis: The donor v0.3.1 source remains byte-for-byte preserved and the new solver is an additive layer.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The run adds the smallest auditable one-axis primitive first and intentionally defers mixed-composer integration rather than silently widening existing semantics.
